International

Global Business

A USA-based contact for equipment sourcing, collaboration enquiries and project-specific discussions with buyers in other countries.

01How we work internationally

Three kinds of conversation.

  • International equipment sourcing

    Tell us what you need to process. We look at suitable machinery and request the technical information to compare it.

  • Business collaboration enquiries

    Engineers, EPC contractors, traders and project developers who want to discuss working together on an enquiry.

  • Project-specific discussions

    A defined project with a product, capacity, location and timeline. We take it from first brief to written quotation.

02Reference project context

Local Presence. Global Business Perspective.

Smarctek is based in Glastonbury, Connecticut.

The reference proposal on our Projects page pairs machinery of Türkiye origin with a project destination in Luanda, Angola. It shows the kind of cross-border enquiry we discuss. It is not evidence of Smarctek offices or established operations in Türkiye or Angola.

03Your first message

What helps us reply quickly.

  • Your country and the project location
  • The product you want to process
  • Required capacity, with the time basis (per hour, per day)
  • Equipment you already have in mind
  • Expected timeline
  • Any drawings or specifications you can attach
